claims.text: Masked Document Generation (MDG) is a task that learns to recover a document with a masked span of tokens.
In MDG, segments of documents are used to predict the original content after masking a portion of the text.
MDG involves setting a minimum and maximum length for the masked span of tokens, specifically between 100 and 256 tokens.
